messages:
alex: Heads up — eu2 embeddings are spiking 5xx/503s on canary traffic. Customer impact visible in support queue. I want to swap traffic back to the previous stable release (v2026-03-17-4a7b) immediately and skip the staged canary to stop the cascade. Requesting expedited approval from release leads and oncall.

alex: Quick context: deploy of v2026-03-18-5f9c added an embedding prefetch change; seen ~12% 5xx across canary pods in eu2 for the last 8m.

alex: log sample: ```json
{"error":"TimeoutError","service":"embeddings","region":"eu2","count":320}
```

deploy-bot: @alex received command request — please confirm the exact command to run or use `/deploy traffic-shift` (requires at least one approver).

carolina: Do we have a rollback plan if the previous revision also shows issues? What are the metrics we'll watch during the swap?

alex: Rollback plan: shift back to canary (v2026-03-18-5f9c) if we see error increase >1% above baseline within 5m. Primary metrics: embeddings 5xx rate, p50/p95 latency, error logs count. Dash link: https://dash.internal/reports/eu2-embeddings (watch 5xx and p95).

maddie: infra +1 on targeted swap if oncall is watching. Need an explicit signoff from release lead for skipping canary.

tara: oncall here — I can watch live for 30m. I'll want to see the first 5m window before full rollback. I'm OK with expedited swap as long as we have the runbook open and an owner for post-checks.

tim: I approve bypassing the staged canary given customer impact. Tim (release lead) signs off. Please include rollout note and update the change window.

alex: thanks — executing now. Command: `/deploy traffic-shift --service=embeddings --region=eu2 --from=canary --to=stable --target-version=v2026-03-17-4a7b --percentage=100 --force`

deploy-bot: executing traffic-shift: service=embeddings region=eu2 target=v2026-03-17-4a7b percentage=100 forced=true

deploy-bot: preflight checks: routing healthy, target version has green healthcheck, infra capacity ok. Estimated completion ~45s.

deploy-bot: 25% -> 50% -> 75% -> 100% traffic shifted (eu2) — 100% complete.

alert-bot: Observability update: embeddings 5xx rate dropped from 12.4% to 0.8% within 60s after shift. p95 latency returned to baseline. No new error clusters detected. :thumbsup:

maddie: Nice. I'll keep monitoring logs for the next 30m and will escalate if anything looks suspect. Opening a short runbook note under incident/EMB-1725.

carolina: Release notes updated with the emergency swap and root cause hypothesis. Filing a follow-up postmortem task for the prefetch change.

alex: Closing this thread. Thanks all for quick approvals and watches. Will ping again if rollback becomes necessary. :rocket:
